title: NC-PLUS-LOOPBREAK-FM-no-deploy-evidence: Record dispatch outcomes (success/failure + error) for FM items in D1 so no dispatch ends without evidence
body:
**Owner:** operations
**Trigger:** the backlog item PLUS-LOOPBREAK-FM-no-deploy-evidence was parked needs-code by the in-tick doer
**Done check:** cmd:python3 scripts/needs_code_bridge.py --probe PLUS-LOOPBREAK-FM-no-deploy-evidence
**Status:** open

Record dispatch outcomes (success/failure + error) for FM items in D1 so no dispatch ends without evidence

Backlog done check: Every dispatch of FM-no-deploy-evidence has a row in the dispatch_outcomes table with an outcome field (success/failure and error reason); re-dispatch of the item produces an outcome instead of silent failure

Triage: Recording dispatch outcomes requires writing to dispatch_outcomes at dispatch time, but the in-Worker doer only writes backlog D1; outcome logging must be added to the dispatch code path. | first step: Inspect the Worker dispatch handler for FM-no-deploy-evidence to find where dispatch executes, then add a D1 insert of outcome/error after every attem

Bridged from the backlog by scripts/needs_code_bridge.py (NEEDS-CODE-BRIDGE-1). The change is code, data or a test that a loop consumes; a document alone does not close it.
